legend.ver: yes = cue read or seen today on a primary page; partial = part seen, part recall; no = nothing read
legend.tier: A title hero, B loading and posters, C deep cuts
legend.risk: low generic object or colour, medium evokes protected mascot, high needs permission

jupiter_cat_check.verified_symbol: planet of slanted bands, lime #A9D36C to cyan #17B9D2, on black
jupiter_cat_check.note: [Unverified] recall of a cat linked to the founder handle Meow; not confirmed; web search unavailable

entries.name: BONK
entries.cue: Cartoon Shiba-type dog mascot, thumbs-up, in yellow #FFE208 / orange #FC8E03 / red #FF0000. Always "BONK" with exclamation marks. Kit says the dog has no mouth. Official card: shiba head in a yellow disc, red "!!" burst.
entries.egg: A yellow-and-orange striped market awning with a red exclamation-mark pennant, and a mouthless sunny dog-shaped balloon tied to the stall. No disc badge, no red block letters.

entries.name: dogwifhat (WIF)
entries.cue: Shiba puppy photo wearing a chunky pink knitted beanie (CoinGecko token image; CoinGecko text: "a Shiba Inu dog wearing a pink knitted hat").
entries.egg: A small tan dog in a thick rose-pink knit hat sitting very still under a cafe table, staring at nothing. Different pose and breed look from the photo.

entries.name: Popcat (POPCAT)
entries.nickname: [Unverified] cat side of the cat/dog split
entries.cue: White-and-brown cat head with the mouth stretched into a huge round "O". Meme cat is named Oatmeal (CoinGecko). Official site card shows exactly that.
entries.egg: A brown-and-white cat in the bakery window, mouth a perfect round O, a ring doughnut hanging in front of it on a string.

entries.name: MEW (cat in a dogs world)
entries.cue: White cat standing triumphant on a pile of defeated shibas; slogan "For too long dogs have ruled the world"; red #E93323 and black site.
entries.egg: A small white cat standing on top of a stack of dog-food sacks, tail up, with a red banner behind. Dog plush toys lie flopped around it.

entries.name: Pudgy Penguins / PENGU
entries.cue: Chubby blue penguin, orange beak and feet, igloo village on snow (official site card). One penguin wears a blue wizard hat.
entries.egg: An igloo-shaped shaved-ice stall in the park with a soft blue penguin plush on the counter. Own character shapes.

entries.name: Moo Deng (MOODENG)
entries.cue: Chubby baby pygmy hippo, brown, pink open mouth. Real animal, born 10 Jul 2024 at Khao Kheow Open Zoo; name means "bouncy pork" (Wikipedia). Token art shows a hippo sitting on a moon-like rock.
entries.egg: A small brown hippo splashing in the town fountain, mouth open, with a steamed pork-bun cart beside it (bouncy pork).

entries.name: Peanut the Squirrel (PNUT)
entries.cue: Squirrel in a hat with a golden halo, peanuts, "Peanut forever" (official site). Memorial coin for a squirrel euthanised by NY authorities (Wikipedia, Meme coin).
entries.egg: A gentle grey-brown squirrel on a lamp-post bracket holding a peanut, a faint halo-shaped ring of light above it and a small candle below. Keep it kind, not a joke.

entries.name: Fartcoin
entries.cue: The logo is italic text "FARTCOIN" on black, not a picture. The hook is the fart joke and a "Gas Fee" fart sound (CoinGecko). Born from the Truth Terminal "Terminal of Truths" AI chat (link on its CoinGecko page).
entries.egg: A whoopee cushion on a cafe chair with one small pale puff above it. Only the joke is shown, no lettering.

entries.name: Gigachad (GIGA)
entries.cue: Black-and-white chiselled-jaw "Gigachad" face; token honours Ernest Khalimov, the man in the photo (CoinGecko). Real person, so do not copy the face.
entries.egg: A black-and-white gym-window poster of an invented square-jawed man in profile, with a protein shaker on the sill.

entries.name: Useless Coin (USELESS)
entries.cue: Golden-yellow round coin with a cream serif "U" (official site card).
entries.egg: A gold-painted flower pot or doorstop shaped like a coin with a cream capital U, holding a shop door open for nothing.

entries.name: BOOK OF MEME (BOME)
entries.cue: Green frog-face icon (CoinGecko image). Made by artist Darkfarms as an on-chain archive of memes (CoinGecko).
entries.egg: A thick open book on a park bench with a doodled green frog sticker on the cover.

entries.name: Mad Lads
entries.cue: Hot red #F62038 square with a black slanted, lightning-cut "MAD LADS" wordmark (official site card). Character look not verified.
entries.egg: A hot-red poster on a wall with a black jagged lightning frame. No letters and no character.

entries.name: Solana Monkey Business
entries.cue: [Unverified] Pixel-art monkeys, one of the first 2021 Solana PFPs. Site returned an empty challenge page (HTTP 202), so nothing was read today.
entries.egg: A pixel-mosaic monkey in the tile art of a wall mural, one colour block per square.

entries.name: Claynosaurz
entries.cue: Site meta text: "a wild herd embarking on epic adventures ... dino lovers". Dinosaurs. The clay look is from the name; the official image download failed (HTTP 402), so [Unverified].
entries.egg: A hand-modelled clay dino toy in a toyshop window, with visible thumbprints and a slightly lopsided grin.

entries.name: DeGods
entries.cue: Heavy black serif "DeGods" wordmark on white; tagline "the only cool brand in crypto" (official site card).
entries.egg: A black-and-white striped shop awning with a bold fat-serif sign: "the only cool shop in town".

entries.name: Famous Fox Federation
entries.cue: [Unverified] Fox PFPs. famousfoxfederation.com did not resolve (DNS failure), so nothing was read.
entries.egg: An orange fox-shaped weathervane on a rooftop.

entries.name: Cets on Creck
entries.cue: Bold white "CETS", loungers in cat form, "WEN", lime-green "SURRR!" splashes, "no flur" (official site card).
entries.egg: A cat sunbathing in a deck chair on the harbour wall with a lime-green splash on the water beside it.

entries.name: Galactic Geckos
entries.cue: Green gecko in a space-garage cockpit, exposed pink brain, orange-patterned collar; "Galactic Gecko Space Garage" (site card).
entries.egg: A small green gecko mechanic with a spanner in a one-bay garage door marked "Space Garage".

entries.name: Phantom
entries.cue: Lavender #AB9FF3 background, white rounded ghost with two oval eyes, lowercase "phantom" (site card). ToS bans copying the ghost design or colour schemes without consent.
entries.egg: A child in a plain white bed-sheet ghost costume on a bench, round eyeholes, no lavender. Or skip it.

entries.name: Solflare
entries.cue: [Unverified] Yellow sun-flare mark. The site returned no card data and the repo research could not read a brand page.
entries.egg: A brass sunburst wall ornament above the stage door.

entries.name: Backpack
entries.cue: Red backpack icon (red-orange) on charcoal with white wordmark (site card).
entries.egg: A plain red backpack hung on a cafe chair back with one strap dangling. No icon shape copied beyond the backpack itself.

entries.name: Jupiter
entries.cue: Planet logo of slanted bands going lime #A9D36C to cyan #17B9D2 on black. A cat was NOT found on any official page or image (see Jupiter-cat check).
entries.egg: A grey cat napping on the cafe windowsill with a round collar tag painted with slanted lime-to-cyan bands. If the cat claim is wrong, the tag still carries the egg.

entries.name: pump.fun
entries.cue: Capsule pill, half mint-green half white, dark outline (PumpSwap icon). Site hero: smiling green 3D character on a sunny grassy hill. Parody allowed if the title says parody (trademark page).
entries.egg: A half-green, half-white capsule-shaped gumball in a curbside vending machine, or one capsule lying on the pavement. No outline, different green.

entries.name: Axiom
entries.cue: Pale lilac split triangle (pyramid) on black with blue light beams (DefiLlama icon). Site blocked us (403).
entries.egg: Two stacked pale triangle panes in a cafe skylight with blue light spilling through.

entries.name: GMGN
entries.cue: Pixel-art green frog with a tan chest on near-black, pixel "GMGN" wordmark (site card).
entries.egg: A tiny pixel-art frog sticker on a trench lamp-post, built from big square pixels.

entries.name: Raydium
entries.cue: Hexagon outline holding an R, blue-to-purple gradient on navy (DefiLlama icon; site card is a dark purple coin scene).
entries.egg: A hexagonal blue-purple glass tile in a shop window with a beam of light through it.

entries.name: Orca
entries.cue: Black-and-white orca breaching inside a yellow disc, spaced "ORCA" wordmark (site card).
entries.egg: A fishmonger sign: a black-and-white whale on a round yellow board, hung over the harbour stall.

entries.name: Meteora
entries.cue: Logo: orange-pink slashes forming a meteor disc on navy. Site copy: "We build Gud Fee Tek"; the card art shows a sunglasses-wearing orange rock creature.
entries.egg: A comet with sunglasses painted on a surfboard sign by the harbour, with a small chalk line "gud fees".

entries.name: Kamino
entries.cue: Pale sky-blue #CAF2FC with a navy lowercase "kamino" wordmark (site card).
entries.egg: A sky-blue beach hut with a navy awning, set at the harbour edge.

entries.name: Jito
entries.cue: Forest-green #397760 rounded "Jito" wordmark; "The Market Layer of Solana" (site card). MEV pays tips.
entries.egg: A deep-green ceramic tip jar on the cafe counter, overflowing with coins and a little sign "tips".

entries.name: Sanctum
entries.cue: Sky-blue #6EC4FF smiling cloud-face blob with a wide open smile, next to a bold lowercase wordmark (site card).
entries.egg: A smiling sky-blue cloud-shaped weathervane on a rooftop. Own face, not theirs.

entries.name: Marinade
entries.cue: White chef-hat line icon on teal #318D8A; site hero shows a bull in a chef hat.
entries.egg: A steakhouse bull statue wearing a tall chef hat over the restaurant door.

entries.name: Collector Crypt / Jupiter Gacha
entries.cue: Graded trading cards in cyan slab cases (site card). Jupiter Gacha text: "Open packs ... to pull real graded trading cards".
entries.egg: A capsule-toy machine in a shop doorway with one cyan-cased graded card on display. Cards are invented, not real Pokemon art.

entries.name: Helius
entries.cue: Orange #E84125 on black; card shows a glowing orange italic "faster" (site card; hex from research brand page).
entries.egg: An orange neon "faster" sign over the delivery-bike shop, glowing a bit more than the rest.

entries.name: Pyth
entries.cue: Dark navy card: spaced "PYTH", "The Price of Everything", circled P (site card).
entries.egg: A chalkboard on a market stall: "the price of everything", with every price changing.

entries.name: Seeker (Solana Mobile)
entries.cue: Black phone with "SEED VAULT" printed on the back and a three-lens camera block; purple-to-orange gradient card; "The Definitive Web3 Mobile Device" (site card).
entries.egg: A chunky black phone propped on a cafe table back-up, three lens dots, one small engraved shield. A generic phone, not the device render.

entries.name: SKR / .skr handles
entries.cue: ".skr" handle as identity flair among Seeker owners (ct-now). Official page text: "The Native Asset of the Solana Mobile Ecosystem". No visual mark verified.
entries.egg: A brass door plate by a doorbell reading ".skr".

entries.name: ORE
entries.cue: Black card with a copper wire-mesh and corner brackets around the word ORE (site card). The 25-tile (5x5) board is from ct-now / the spec.
entries.egg: A pickaxe leaning on a 5x5 patch of square paving tiles with a copper sheen, a wheelbarrow of ore beside it.

entries.name: Helium
entries.cue: Tagline "Own the Air"; card photo: a woman on a rooftop beside a cell tower (site).
entries.egg: A small antenna box on a rooftop with hexagon roof tiles and bunting reading "own the air".

entries.name: Hivemapper
entries.cue: Dashcam-mapping network; small blue folded-wing glyph beside the wordmark (site card).
entries.egg: A dashcam on a delivery scooter with a small blue sticker on its box.

entries.name: Grass
entries.cue: Line "Get rewarded for the internet you don't use", over a painted green jungle (site card).
entries.egg: A tuft of lime-green grass growing in a pavement crack beside a Wi-Fi router left on a step.

entries.name: Nosana
entries.cue: Neon-green stylised N on dark green (site card).
entries.egg: A neon-green N-shaped crack of light in a dark server-shop doorway.

entries.name: Star Atlas
entries.cue: White "A" chevron over a cyan downward triangle on black; "AAA Space Exploration MMO" (site).
entries.egg: A cyan downward-pointing triangle sail on a toy model starship in the toy-shop window.

entries.name: Aurory
entries.cue: Purple mountain world with a white A inside a ring; "memorable characters" (site card).
entries.egg: A mural of violet mountains and a bridge on a back wall.

entries.name: AI agents / x402
entries.cue: "x402 is the internet's payment standard ... agentic payments" (x402.org). Hook: HTTP 402 "Payment Required". Truth Terminal AI lineage also feeds Fartcoin.
entries.egg: A small robot courier at a toll bar with a sign "402: payment required".

entries.name: Solana
entries.cue: Purple #9945FF to green #14F195 gradient; three stacked slanted bars (site card, branding page). Brand page forbids implying a connection without permission.
entries.egg: Use the gradient only as a sunset sky wash. No logo or bars. Optionally three stacked slanted roof tiles.

entries.name: Superteam
entries.cue: Super Purple #5522e0 and Super Yellow #f4a60b with tints #bcb3ff and #ffd9a1. No mascot (brand page).
entries.egg: Purple-and-yellow triangle bunting strung across a side street.

entries.name: Superteam Nigeria
entries.cue: Same purple-yellow pair (brand page). Nigeria is the only African chapter listed (eco). [Unverified] The yellow-and-black Lagos danfo bus is from recall, not fetched.
entries.egg: A yellow bus with a black stripe and a purple door, bunting tied to its mirror, parked at the left edge.

entries.name: Colosseum
entries.cue: "Enter the Arena" in blackletter, line art of a column and amphitheatre, pale grey (site card).
entries.egg: A small arched round hall in the background with a banner reading "ENTER" in blackletter.

entries.name: Breakpoint 2026
entries.cue: White and navy with a coral gradient; "BUILD. DEPLOY. SHIP MORE."; Olympia London, 15-17 Nov (solana.com/breakpoint).
entries.egg: A lanyard badge pinned to a notice board plus a "Checkpoint" banner in navy and coral.

excluded.name: Okay Bears
excluded.why: Site pivoted to a charity T-shirt business (eco)

excluded.name: y00ts
excluded.why: y00ts.com served the DeGods page when fetched today; no separate brand to show

excluded.name: Retardio / Retardio Cousins
excluded.why: CoinGecko 24h volume about $11.6k on 8 Oct; Cousins floor 0.72 SOL (eco)

excluded.name: Tensor / Tensorians, Magic Eden
excluded.why: TVL near zero (eco). Tensor card is a white double-arrow T on black if you want it back

excluded.name: ElizaOS / ai16z, Zerebro, GOAT
excluded.why: Tokens faded (eco). elizaos.ai now serves "Eliza Research" (orange card, spectacled girl)

excluded.name: Bags, Pacifica, Phoenix, Loopscale, StonkFun
excluded.why: Small or no distinctive cue found

excluded.name: Metaplex, Wormhole, Render, GEODNET, fomo
excluded.why: Dropped: card shows only a wordmark or generic art, no cue an insider would spot. fomo icon is a white looped shape on navy

placements.note: A yellow bus with a black stripe fills the far-left edge as a framing block. Purple door, purple-and-yellow bunting runs from its mirror up to a lamp-post. Only the nose and door are in frame, so the egg is the colour pair, not a sign.
Pickaxe against the kerb on a 5x5 patch of copper-sheen paving tiles, with a wheelbarrow of ore. Sits at the lower left, outside the open centre ground.
Grey cat asleep on the cafe windowsill, collar tag painted with slanted lime-to-cyan bands. It is the warmest, softest detail in the left third.
Black three-lens phone propped face-down on the table, a coffee next to it.
Red backpack hanging from the chair back. It is the strongest red on the left, so keep the rest of the left side cooler.
Small tan dog in a thick rose-pink knit hat, very still, looking out at the viewer. A tiny acting beat, not a second hero.
Ask first. If used: a child in a plain white sheet-ghost costume on the bench by the lamp-post, no lavender anywhere. If not cleared, drop it and nothing else changes.
Small arched round hall behind the cafe roofs, with a blackletter ENTER banner. It anchors the top-left skyline and leaves the top centre open.
Small brown hippo mid-splash in the fountain, mouth open. The fountain is the focal prop; the lower-centre ground in front stays clear cobblestone for buttons.
Sky is a soft purple (top) to warm teal-green (low) sunset wash. No logo, no bars. Keep the top centre as flat open gradient for the title.
Brown-and-white cat in the bakery window, mouth a round O, ring doughnut on a string in front. One window, small.
Hand-modelled clay dino toy in the toyshop window, thumbprints showing. Next window along, a plain half-open book shop. Nothing else on this shop front.
Yellow-and-orange striped awning on the market stall with a red exclamation-mark pennant and a mouthless dog balloon tied to a pole.

Curbside vending machine with a half-green, half-white capsule gumball behind the glass. This is the one saturated green on the right and frames the right edge. A single capsule on the pavement below it.
